findings: Native multiclass rule selects minimum raw class energy and rejects only if it exceeds that winning class training cutoff.
Default cutoff index is floor(n*0.95) in sorted own-class TRAIN energies; multiclass equality is accepted.
Numeric preprocessing is MaxAbsScaler then 30 quantile bins; categorical columns pass through after external encoding.
Preprocessing sees all supplied fit rows before class separation; no validation/test passed by the package itself.
Package returns only winning energy, not a normalized class-probability matrix.
Package leaves discretizer subsample/random_state/quantile_method to dependency defaults; local defaults are 200000/None/averaged_inverted_cdf.
Cython compilation and finite numerical behavior have not been tested here.
Per-class pair table requires 8*(p*q)^2 bytes; coupling 8*(p*(q-1))^2 bytes, plus data, temporary matrices and concurrent estimators.
Changing energy cutoffs to a validation-budget policy is a separately labeled adaptation, not an unchanged native reproduction.
license_file_structure: Three-clause BSD-style notice; upstream notice retained in ignored checkout
